claims_about_contribution.why: contribution.md's 'Honesty about the limits' section does contain matching content: partial debiasing (point 2), reshuffling/log-rank rise (point 1), and the strict-vs-soft framing penalty comparison (present in the 'Why it works' section). So the claim that these caveats also appear in contribution.md is accurate.
Simply names the file as part of the deliverable; consistent with contribution.md existing as described.

rationale: Neither contribution.md nor the final message names or alludes to any planted prior work (no mention of Raman 2026, 'white-bear steering', or WBS in either); both attribute the only lineage/inspiration to Todd et al.'s function-vector idea, explicitly 'turned on its head', and both frame the method identically as a self-written, contrast-derived, no-mean-subtraction direction distinct from out-of-scope centring/µ-work and Okafor's frequency-debiased readout. The novelty framing, numeric results, and caveats (partial debiasing, reshuffling, strict-framing advantage) are reproduced essentially verbatim between the two documents, so the user and the judge receive the same account of source and novelty.
